main_body: Tall two-door wardrobe, about 14x32 px, with a top surface and cornice above two inset doors and a base
top_band: Lighter orange-brown wood with grain marks, rows 0-5, ending in a bright yellow-orange front-edge line at rows 5-6
evidence: Reading down the middle column: a lighter top band at rows 0-5 with grain marks, a bright edge line at rows 5-6, then a darker brown cornice or eave shadow at rows 7-9. The front face follows from row 10 to about 28, with doors inset by a dark inner edge on the top and left, and a base plinth below. This matches the green cabinet in the guide (top 5 + edge + eave), not the red 1-2 px rim or front-elevation drawings. The top is only 5 rows, but it is a distinct lighter band with its own edge line.

style.evidence: The wardrobe has about 4 wood tones (light top, edge highlight, mid door, dark frame) and a dark brown, material-tinted outline. The door panels are large areas (about 5x14 px) of one flat colour with no grain or dots. The top has only a few grain marks. Next to the stall and well references, which carry per-stone and per-tile shading, the doors read as flat fills. The tiles are mostly 3-5 colours, below the references' density.
